# `oaap user`

portal accounts of this node: list, add, delete, password.

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap user {list,add,delete,schedule,password,unbind} [username] [password] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `--roles ROLES` | 'add': comma-separated, default 'user'; server_admin is refused at this door |
| `--groups GROUPS` | 'add': comma-separated visibility groups (RFC-0007) |
| `--display-name DISPLAY_NAME` | 'add': the name shown in the portal |
| `--tenant TENANT` | 'add': tenant label or id; default is this node's default tenant |
| `--password-file PASSWORD_FILE` | 'add': read the initial password from this file |
| `--generate` | 'add': make a password and print it ONCE |
| `--keep-password` | 'add'/'password': do NOT force a new password at the first sign-in (RFC-0046 §6.2) |
| `--deactivate-at DEACTIVATE_AT` | 'add'/'schedule': date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) from which the user cannot sign in; '' clears |
| `--delete-at DELETE_AT` | 'add'/'schedule': date on which the user is deleted (only when nothing of theirs is left); '' clears |
| `--reason REASON` | 'add'/'schedule': why the dates exist, e.g. 'cohort kurs-2026-10' |
| `--clear` | 'schedule': remove both dates |
| `--yes` | 'delete': do not ask for the username again |
| `--keep-active` | 'unbind' only: break the binding without deactivating the account (repairing a binding rather than revoking access) |
| `username` | -- |
| `password` | omit to be prompted (hidden input) -- 'password' action only |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `list` | yes |
| `add` | yes |
| `delete` | yes |
| `schedule` | yes |
| `password` | yes |
| `unbind` | yes |
